programme.desc: S15 E1 — Horror of Fang Rock: Part 1 The TARDIS lands on Fang Rock island at the start of the 20th century. There the Doctor and Leela discover a lighthouse keeper has been killed and a creature is at large.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S15 E2 — Horror of Fang Rock: Part 2 A thick fog surrounds Fang Rock and a ship is wrecked. The survivors take shelter in the lighthouse but all are in deadly peril from the alien menace that stalks the island.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S15 E3 — Horror of Fang Rock: Part 3 The Doctor seals the survivors inside the lighthouse but discovers that he may unwittingly have trapped the creature inside with them.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S15 E4 — Horror of Fang Rock: Part 4 As the alien Rutan picks off the remaining humans one by one, the Doctor devises a desperate plan to defeat the alien and repel the approaching Rutan mothership.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S15 E5 — The Invisible Enemy: Part 1 An alien virus infects the human crew of a refuelling station on Titan, one of the moons of Saturn. The Doctor is also infected and becomes possessed by the will of the Nucleus.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S15 E6 — The Invisible Enemy: Part 2 As the Doctor's condition worsens, he instructs Leela to pilot the TARDIS to the Bi-Al Foundation. The only chance of curing the Doctor is to literally get inside his head.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S15 E7 — The Invisible Enemy: Part 3 The Doctor and Leela have been cloned and miniaturised and injected into the Doctor's body. There they must fight the virus on a microscopic level before time runs out.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S15 E8 — The Invisible Enemy: Part 4 The Nucleus has escaped the Doctor's body and grown to human size. Its plans to spawn and infect the whole galaxy are nearing fruition. And it looks like K-9 has a new master….
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S15 E9 — Image of the Fendahl: Part 1 The Doctor and Leela arrive in present day England at Fetch Priory where a mysterious skull that is older than mankind is exerting a deadly influence on those around it.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S15 E10 — Image of the Fendahl: Part 2 As Thea succumbs to the power of the skull, the Doctor realises that an ancient horror from the mythology of his own people is manifesting at Fetch Priory.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S15 E11 — Image of the Fendahl: Part 3 Stahl intends to control the power of the Fendahl for himself. The Doctor and Leela take a trip in the TARDIS to discover the truth about the ancient evil from the dawn of time.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S15 E12 — Image of the Fendahl: Part 4 Thea has become the Fendahl Core and Stahl realises that he is out of his depth as his followers transform into the hideous, snake-like Fendahleen.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S15 E17 — Underworld: Part 1 The TARDIS lands on a spaceship which is crewed by the survivors of the planet Minyos who are on a quest to find the lost ship, the P7E. Their journey has taken them 100,000 years.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S15 E18 — Underworld: Part 2 When their ship crashes beneath the surface of a newly formed planet, the Minyan survivors discover what they have been searching for. But their arrival is not welcomed.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S15 E19 — Underworld: Part 3 The Doctor and Leela attempt to penetrate the Citadel of the Seers to rescue Idas’s father who has been sentenced to death.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S15 E20 — Underworld: Part 4 The Minyans are eager to recover the race banks that they have waited so long to find, but the Doctor becomes suspicious when the Oracle simply allows Jackson to take them.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S15 E21 — The Invasion of Time: Part 1 Leela is concerned by the Doctor’s strange behaviour when, after a secret meeting with aliens, he returns to Gallifrey and abruptly stakes his claim on the Time Lord presidency.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S15 E22 — The Invasion of Time: Part 2 The Doctor is made president of the Time Lords and immediately orders K9 to lower the planet’s defences and has Leela banished to the wilderness.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S15 E23 — The Invasion of Time: Part 3 The Doctor has betrayed his own people and enabled a Vardan invasion of Gallifrey. Leela joins forces with the Outsiders and prepares to strike back against the aliens.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S15 E24 — The Invasion of Time: Part 4 As the Vardans finally fully materialise on Gallifrey, the Doctor prepares to spring his trap. But does a more deadly alien force lie behind the Vardans?
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S15 E25 — The Invasion of Time: Part 5 The Sontarans have taken control of the Capital on Gallifrey and intend to use the power of the Time Lords to rampage through all of time.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S15 E26 — The Invasion of Time: Part 6 Stor, the Sontaran leader, finally gains access to the TARDIS in search of the Great Key of Rassilon and a dangerous game of hide and seek begins inside the Doctor’s ship.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S16 E1 — The Ribos Operation: Part 1 On a mission to collect the six segments of the Key to Time, the Doctor and Romana travel to the planet Ribos where the first segment is protected by the monstrous Shrivenzale.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S16 E2 — The Ribos Operation: Part 2 Garron is attempting to trick the Graff Vynda-K into buying the planet Ribos, but the jethrik that is vital to his plan is really the first segment of the Key to Time.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S16 E3 — The Ribos Operation: Part 3 The Doctor and Romana's search for the first segment of the Key to Time is hampered when the Graff Vynda-K takes them prisoner.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S16 E4 — The Ribos Operation: Part 4 Pursued into the catacombs by the Graff and attacked by the ferocious Shrivenzale, the Doctor and Romana struggle to stay alive and find the first segment of the Key to Time.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S16 E5 — The Pirate Planet: Part 1 In search of the second segment of the Key to Time, the Doctor and Romana travel to the planet Calufrax. But they find that a completely different planet has taken its place.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S16 E6 — The Pirate Planet: Part 2 Still in search of the missing planet, Calufrax, the Doctor and Romana encounter the telepathic Mentiads and Zanak’s ruler, the half man, half robot Captain.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S16 E7 — The Pirate Planet: Part 3 The Doctor has discovered the sinister truth about Zanak and solved the mystery of the missing planet. On the Bridge, the Doctor meets the real ruler of Zanak.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S16 E8 — The Pirate Planet: Part 4 The Doctor and Romana join forces with the Mentiads to prevent the Captain and Xanxia from using Zanak to consume the Earth.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S16 E9 — The Stones of Blood: Part 1 The Doctor and Romana track the third segment of the Key to Time to the vicinity of an ancient stone circle on Earth. But sinister forces are at work and the stones hide a secret.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S16 E10 — The Stones of Blood: Part 2 The leaders of a druidic cult have been killed and it seems that the stones from the stone circle are alive and have a taste for human blood.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S16 E11 — The Stones of Blood: Part 3 As the blood hungry Ogri close in, the Doctor launches a desperate attempt to rescue Romana from hyperspace.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S16 E12 — The Stones of Blood: Part 4 The Doctor releases two alien justice machines from imprisonment who sentenc him to death. Meanwhile Romana urgently searches for clues that will reveal Vivien Fay’s true identity.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who
